verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way for customers to choose a data storage region or residency for LaunchDarkly data. The federal-environment page only states that a separate instance is FedRAMP-compliant; that is a compliance posture, not a documented region choice. The Relay Proxy runs on your own infrastructure but only proxies the streaming connection, so it is adjacent and does not let you choose where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
